tools.name: list_services
tools.description: What Iconic CLS runs, what each service needs in order to be priced, which airports and private airfields are covered, and where a human books. Read this before quoting.

tools.name: quote_trip
tools.description: Price one trip and get back a single fixed all-in total in USD, including the Operations & Chauffeur Fee. Standard rates, no account needed, nothing stored. The total is an estimate: an account with negotiated rates prices differently.

service.description: Which service to price. Call list_services for what each one covers.

pickup.description: Street address the trip starts from. Omit for the airport end of an arrival.

dropoff.description: Street address the trip ends at. Omit for the airport end of a departure.

airport_code.description: IATA code, e.g. "BUR" or "VNY". Assumed LAX for the lax service.

addon.description: Airport add-on. meetgreet is arrivals only, departure is departures only.

baggage_valet.description: Bags collected and carried through. Arrivals only.

hours.description: Length of the block. Required for hourly and shuttle.

extra_stops.description: Count of unaddressed extra stops on an hourly booking.

car_seats.description: Number of child car seats required.

tools.name: book_trip
tools.description: Place a real booking with no account. The car is held for 30 minutes and a payment link comes back; the person you are helping opens it and pays the full fare, and the trip confirms itself the moment the money lands. You cannot complete the payment yourself, so hand them the link. Quote it first so you can tell them the price. To change or cancel afterwards, text +1 424-487-4875 — the house's automated line, answered around the clock — or call +1 310-757-5588 to reach the live concierge.

extra_stops.description: Count of unaddressed extra stops on an hourly booking.

car_seats.description: Number of child car seats required.

date.description: Date of travel, YYYY-MM-DD, Los Angeles time.

time.description: Pickup time, HH:MM, 24-hour, Los Angeles time.

passenger_name.description: Full name of the person riding. Required: it is the name on the trip and what the chauffeur asks for.

phone.description: Mobile number for the rider, with a country code if it is not US. Required: the chauffeur has to be able to reach them, and the confirmation is texted here.

flight_number.description: Flight number, so the chauffeur can track the arrival.

notes.description: Anything the chauffeur should know. Passed through verbatim.
